rules.statement: A deed conveying title to immovable property executed by a minor is voidable and not void because he has a title to convey, and it is only the minor who can plead that the deed is void owing to his minority. A deed executed by a person who has no title to convey is void against all the world.
rules.supporting_quote: "A deed conveying title to immovable property executed by a 1929. minor is voidable and not void because he has a title to convey, and it is only the minor who can plead that the deed is void owing to his minority. A deed executed by a person who has no title to convey is void against all the world."
